description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'OrleansQueries' responsible for managing prepared Cassandra queries related to Orleans membership clustering. It includes methods for creating, verifying, updating, and reading membership and cluster version data, as well as handling Cassandra table setup. The class leverages Cassandra's CQL via the Cassandra .NET driver, and implements logic for ensuring table existence, consistency level management, and prepared statement handling.

classes.name: OrleansQueries
classes.description: Class managing prepared Cassandra queries for Orleans clustering membership, including creation, verification, updating, reading, and table setup.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of OrleansQueries asynchronously, initializing it with a given ISession.

methods.name: EnsureTableExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if the membership table exists in Cassandra, and if not, creates it, with retries on write timeout.

methods.name: EnsureClusterVersionExistsAsync
methods.description: Ensures the cluster version record exists; inserts it if missing, with retry logic.

methods.name: MembershipReadVersion
methods.description: Prepares a statement to read the membership version for a given cluster identifier.

methods.name: MembershipReadAll
methods.description: Prepares a statement to read all membership entries for a cluster.

methods.name: MembershipReadRow
methods.description: Prepares a statement to read a specific membership entry based on a silo address.

methods.name: GatewaysQuery
methods.description: Prepares a query to retrieve gateways with a given status.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTime
methods.description: Prepares a statement to update the 'IAmAliveTime' for a membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTimeWithTtL
methods.description: Prepares a TTL-aware update for the 'IAmAliveTime', respecting row-level TTL semantics.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipEntry
methods.description: Prepares a statement to delete a membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateMembership
methods.description: Prepares an update statement for membership, handling versioning and status.

methods.name: InsertMembership
methods.description: Prepares a statement to insert or update a membership entry.

methods.name: InsertMembershipVersion
methods.description: Prepares a statement to insert the membership version if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Prepares a statement to delete all entries from the membership table for a cluster.

methods.name: CheckIfClusterVersionExists
methods.description: Creates a statement to check if a cluster version exists for a given identifier.

methods.name: CheckIfTableExists
methods.description: Creates a statement to verify existence of the 'membership' table in keyspace.

methods.name: EnsureTableExists
methods.description: Creates a Cassandra table creation statement for the 'membership' table with optional TTL.
